mentions.name: PyneSys
mentions.description: A Pine Script compiler and full-featured IDE for Pine Script, with syntax highlighting, a language server, a full-featured debugger, charting, and data downloads. It is 99.771% bit exact on the top 1000 Pine Scripts and achieves a 100% trade match.
mentions.source_excerpt: And a Pine Script compiler for it + a full IDE for Pine Script with syntax highlight, language server, full featured debugger, charting, data downloads: https://pynesys.io .
